notes: The report is printed as images, apart from the auditor's report (p.28), so the page text is Apple Vision OCR (data/agency-reports/ocr/). Every figure was read against the page image.

The five-year financial summary (p.16) is not recorded: OCR dropped its figures (the one figure it kept, '18808' against Sale of good and services, misreads 111,193). The finance totals come from the comprehensive operating statement (p.29).

Net result: OCR misread the comprehensive operating statement cell (p.29) as '130,18ął'. The page image shows 130,180, and the statement of changes in equity (p.30) Total column reads 130,180 in both the image and the OCR text, so that cell is recorded.

Accountable Officer remuneration: the page image (p.41) prints 'Remuneration received or receivable by the Accountable Officer in connection with the management of VCET during the reporting period was in the range: $510,000-$519,999', but OCR dropped the line naming the Accountable Officer, so the band is not tied to the role in the page text and is not recorded.
Executive officers table (p.41): the page image shows 6 executives and 6 annualised employee equivalents for 2026; OCR dropped both 2026 cells, so neither is recorded.
Key management personnel remuneration (p.42): the page image shows a total of 2,938 ($'000) for 2026 (2025: 2,701), but OCR reads 2,050 and 2,101. It is not recorded.

Consultancies valued at $10,000 or greater (p.22): the page image lists Corrs Chambers Westgarth (1,014), Victorian Chamber of Commerce and Industry (60), Right Lane Consulting (23), Consultix Australia (14) and Autism Spectrum (Aspect) (12), all $'000. OCR split each consultant's name across lines and misread Consultix as 'Consutx', so no row can be quoted with its consultant and none is recorded.

Workforce (p.21): the report gives 350 full-time employees, the full-time equivalent of 24 part-time employees and 568 casual employees, but no total FTE or headcount, so staff_fte and staff_headcount are in not_found.

The headline figures 838K+ delegates, 130K+ potential attendees (p.7) and 3.35 million visitors (p.4) are not recorded because they are not plain numbers in a listed unit; the chair's foreword prints 838,872 delegates (p.4), which OCR reads as '838.872', so it is not recorded either.
